## Core packages

| Package | Purpose | Install |
|---------|---------|---------|
| `ggplot2` | Core visualization | `install.packages("ggplot2")` |
| `ggthemes` | Extra themes & scales | `install.packages("ggthemes")` |
| `hrbrthemes` | Typography-centric themes | `install.packages("hrbrthemes")` |
| `ggdark` | Dark mode themes | `install.packages("ggdark")` |
| `patchwork` | Combine multiple plots | `install.packages("patchwork")` |
| `ggrepel` | Non-overlapping labels | `install.packages("ggrepel")` |
| `ggtext` | Markdown/HTML in plots | `install.packages("ggtext")` |
| `gridExtra` | Grid layouts | `install.packages("gridExtra")` |
| `cowplot` | Publication-ready layouts | `install.packages("cowplot")` |
| `scales` | Axis formatting helpers | `install.packages("scales")` |

## Quick-start

Install everything at once:

```r
pkgs <- c(
  "ggplot2", "ggthemes", "hrbrthemes", "ggdark",
  "patchwork", "ggrepel", "ggtext", "gridExtra",
  "cowplot", "scales", "tidyverse"
)
install.packages(pkgs)
```

Your first ggplot2 plot:

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, lwd = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#e84855", "#2d6be4", "#12a36a")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Vehicle Weight vs Fuel Economy",
    subtitle = "Grouped by number of cylinders · mtcars dataset",
    x        = "Weight (1,000 lbs)",
    y        = "Miles per Gallon",
    colour   = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
